question: Does the confirmed TSX scanner hotspot gain produce at least 3% lower native HTML latency in current Ferriki main?
boundary: Native full HTML over the two curated TSX fixtures; includes tokenization and Rust rendering, excludes the unchanged Node facade.
order: Existing paired native harness rotates engine order each round inside each independent process.
summary: Median paired worker latency ratios and a fixed-seed 10,000-resample bootstrap 95% interval over the eight worker ratios.
decision: A target-case runtime reduction of at least 3% with an upper 95% endpoint below zero triggers the homepage guard. Otherwise retain the draft and stop latency measurements.

conditional_homepage_guard.rule: Every document warm and cold upper 95% endpoint must be at most +2%; no optional cohort extension.
